descricao_original: The difference in staining qualities between serous acini and mucous tubules is obvious. Mucous tubules are elongated and stain palely due to the frothy, mucus content of the tubule cells. In contrast, the cytoplasm of the serous acinar cells stains darkly, reflecting their numerous secretory granules. No ducts are visible here. 400x
